shortDescription: Manage VLANs on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches

options.name: associated_interfaces
options.description: This is a intent option and checks the operational state of the for given vlan C(name) for associated interfaces. If the value in the C(associated_interfaces) does not match with the operational state of vlan interfaces on device it will result in failure.

options.name: associated_tagged
options.description: This is a intent option and checks the operational state of  given vlan C(name) for associated tagged ports and lags. If the value in the C(associated_tagged) does not match with the operational state of vlan interfaces on device it will result in failure.

options.name: check_running_config
options.description: Check running configuration. This can be set as environment variable. Module will use environment variable value(default:False), unless it is overridden, by specifying it as module parameter.

options.name: delay
options.description: Delay the play should wait to check for declarative intent params values.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: List of ethernet ports or LAGS to be added as access(untagged) ports to the vlan. To add a range of ports use 'to' keyword. See the example.

options.name: ip_arp_inspection
options.description: Enables dynamic ARP inspection on a VLAN.

options.name: ip_dhcp_snooping
options.description: Enables DHCP snooping on a VLAN.

options.name: purge
options.description: Purge VLANs not defined in the I(aggregate) parameter.

options.name: tagged
options.description: List of ethernet ports or LAGS to be added as trunk(tagged) ports to the vlan. To add a range of ports use 'to' keyword. See the example.
